descriptionChirho: A noun (tsaphir) denoting a male goat or he-goat, used in ritual and prophetic contexts. Appears in singular (Dan 8:5,8,21 — the prominent male goat in Daniel's vision; 2 Chr 29:21) and plural construct (Ezra 8:35; 2 Chr 29:21 — 'male goats for'). Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'male goat(s)', spa 'macho(s) cabrío(s)', hin बकरा/बक्रोन, arb التَّيْسُ/تُيُوسَ, kor 숙염소/숫염소들, swa 'beberu/mbuzi'. The singular vs. plural distinction is grammatical number, not a separate lexicographic sense.
